answers.answer: The Ready column shows an error message (e.g. "Couldn't load Ready") with a "Retry" button and no cards. The count line under the filters counts only the loaded cards and leaves out Ready's cards.
The board is shown with all five columns loaded and the error screen gone. 2 board loads were requested. Focus is on the board (main heading or region), not on the removed "Try again" button.
The window title shows the card key and title, e.g. "SL-102 · <card title> – Slate". 2 card loads were requested.
The address is still #/ because the filter is debounced by 250 ms. Backlog still shows all its cards (SL-101 to SL-110).
The address is #/?q=login%20fix. The history did not grow, so it still has 1 entry, because the filter replaces the entry. Backlog shows only SL-102 and Ready shows no cards (empty state).
Focus is on card SL-125. Enter applies the filter at once and moves focus to the first match.

The address is normalised to #/?labels=perf,bug&q=search%20results. The unknown label is dropped and the query is trimmed with its spaces collapsed. The history did not grow (replace, 1 entry). The cards shown are those with both labels perf and bug that match "search results", probably SL-109.
Focus is on the second card of Review (SL-122), the same row in the next column.
Focus leaves the card list, because the cards use a roving tabindex. It goes to the next control after the board (not to SL-105).
The address is #/. The first Escape clears the filter field, the second Escape leaves the field, and focus returns to the board.
0 cards are selected. x selects SL-111, the first Shift+X selects all 7 Ready cards, and the second Shift+X clears them.
In progress holds its original cards followed by SL-101, SL-102 and SL-103. The notice says "Moved 3 cards to In progress" with an "Undo" action. SL-101, SL-102 and SL-103 stay selected.

The notice says "Moved 2 of 3 cards to Review. 1 failed." with the actions "Retry" and "Undo". Only SL-107 stays selected. Backlog order is SL-101, SL-102, SL-103, SL-104, SL-105, SL-107, SL-109, SL-110. Review is its original cards followed by SL-106 and SL-108.
7 cards are still selected. Filtering does not change the selection.
SL-119 is in Review. The notice says "Moved SL-119 to Review" with an "Undo" action.
SL-116 is in In progress. The notice says "Moved SL-116 to In progress" with an "Undo" action. 2 move requests were sent in all.

Ready order is SL-111, SL-112, SL-101, SL-113, followed by the remaining Ready cards. The drop lands before SL-113 because the pointer is not past its midpoint. The notice says "Moved SL-101 to Ready" with an "Undo" action.
SL-107 is back in Backlog after the rollback. Focus is on card SL-107. The notice says "Couldn't move SL-107 to Ready." with the actions "Retry" and "Dismiss".
SL-107 is in Ready. The notice says "Moved SL-107 to Ready" with an "Undo" action.
SL-108 is back in Ready, because the undo failed and was rolled back. The notice says "Couldn't undo the move of SL-108." with a "Retry" action.
Focus is on card SL-109, the previous card. No delete request is sent yet, because the delete is deferred behind an undo notice.
No delete request has been sent, and the notice is still shown.
Yes, a delete request has been sent, and the notice is gone.
SL-105 is back in Backlog at its original position. Focus is on card SL-105. No delete request was sent.
1 delete request has been sent, for SL-103, because a new delete commits the pending one. The notice says "Deleted SL-105" with an "Undo" action.
SL-125 is restored to its column (Done). The notice says "Couldn't delete SL-125." with a "Retry" action.
Yes, the notice is still shown. Error notices stay until dismissed.
SL-101 is still in Ready. 1 move request was sent. The notice is still shown, because Control+Z inside the text field is the field's own undo and not the app's.
The message "Title must be 80 characters or fewer." is shown. Focus stays in the Title field. No save was sent.
Yes, the title is accepted. Focus returns to the "Edit title" button. A save was sent.
The original title is shown. The message "Title is required." is shown. No save was sent.
Only the three applied labels (bug, ui, perf) can be pressed, to remove them. The other label buttons are disabled. The note says "A card can have at most 3 labels."
The new comment shows the trimmed text "First note" in a pending state (e.g. "Sending…"). The comment field is disabled, so the user cannot type.

The address is #/card/SL-114. Focus is on the card detail panel (the comment field is left). No comment was sent. Enter only adds a line break, and Escape does not close the card while a draft exists.
The Comments section shows the loaded list of SL-120's comments, with no error and no Retry button.
The address is #/?labels=bug. Opening the card added 1 entry and Escape went back, so the history has the same number of entries as at the start. Focus is on card SL-114.
The card view for SL-114 is shown again. The history has 2 entries compared with 1 at the start: the link pushed an entry and Back moved to the first one. 2 card loads were requested in all.
The page shows a loading state for the card. The window title is "Slate". A card load was requested.

ambiguities: PRB-019: the text does not say whether filtering removes hidden cards from the selection.
PRB-023: the midpoint of SL-113 is ambiguous (before or after the card).
PRB-016: "what stays selected" can mean the moved cards stay selected or the selection is cleared.
PRB-050: it is unclear whether Back re-requests the card or reuses the cache.
PRB-014: the first Escape can clear the field text or only blur the field.
